faqs.a: A free licence for work or school accounts covers cloud flows with standard connectors. Premium is $15.00 per user a month, paid yearly.

faqs.q: What is an alternative to Power Automate Desktop?
faqs.a: UiPath, for enterprise RPA. Its Community plan is free and Basic starts at $25 a month.

faqs.q: How many connectors does Power Automate have?
faqs.a: Microsoft lists more than 1,400 prebuilt connectors. 50agents works with 2,300+ apps through viaSocket.
Premium is $15 per user a month, paid yearly. Process is $150 per bot a month, paid yearly, for unattended RPA.

faqs.q: How do I export Power Automate flows?
faqs.a: Flows export as a package (.zip) or inside a solution. Use the export as your checklist when you rebuild elsewhere.
Power Automate is built into Microsoft 365, with approvals and process mining.
UiPath builds enterprise robotic process automation and AI agents. Its Community plan is free forever, and Basic starts at $25 a month.
